## Checklist

- [ ] One logical change, no unrelated refactors or reformatting; under a few hundred lines (or agreed in an issue)
- [ ] Tests for new behaviour, a regression test for a fix (where testable)
- [ ] Docs and CHANGELOG.md updated
- [ ] No personal paths, host names, secrets, vendored binaries or firmware
- [ ] Every commit has my `Signed-off-by:` (`git commit -s`, the [DCO](https://developercertificate.org/))
- [ ] AI assistance: none / used, and I have read, run and stand behind every line (commits carry `Co-Authored-By:`)
